review: Focused perceptual review of actual-GPU stills

source_identity.identity_evidence: Build identity supplied in the review handoff; not independently recomputed in this focused still review.

result: accepted within the focused still-review scope
findings: In the grasp and hold views, the hand appears seated around the heel/ankle; no material detachment or visibly impossible wrist is apparent at the displayed scale.
No conspicuous broken neck shape is apparent in the two supplied 4826 and 4001 views.
The approach, grasp, hold and release stills show successive poses around the raised foot. Small angular attachment and joint creases were accepted in the review brief.
limits: Stills cannot establish continuous acquisition and release choreography, timing, or motion between samples. The approach and release samples still show the hand close to or overlapping the foot.
The hand and foot overlap and share a similar color, so the stills do not conclusively establish whether individual digits pass through the foot or make surface contact.
Only the supplied views were inspected; no audio, playback, other exercises, or independent build identity verification was reviewed.
